result.topic_en: The page concludes the analysis of a hanging rope (its shape, the inclination at the endpoints, the tensions at the lowest and highest points, and a series expansion for small depth), then states Problem II: find the curve a flexible thread takes under wind pressure (the velaria), with the start of its solution.

items.english: Whence it is clear that the smaller the depth AX = x for the same length of rope, the greater the tension required at the points M and N, so that the rope cannot be stretched completely straight except by an infinite force.

items.english: If a perfectly flexible thread of uniform thickness is exposed to the wind, determine the curve that the force of the wind will give it, disregarding the weight of the thread; that is, investigate the velaria (sail curve).
